# VKS UI (@vks-kit/ui)

> Shared React 19 + Tailwind v4 design system for VKS Security apps (Guard Navy + Gold, Lao-first, mobile-first). Search this list before building any UI: reuse a part if it fits, extend it with a prop/variant if it almost fits, and only then add a new part to packages/ui + apps/gallery + apps/docs.

Rules: import only from "@vks-kit/ui" (icons from "@vks-kit/ui/icons", heavy parts from "@vks-kit/ui/charts" | "/map" | "/kanban" | "/scan"); colours only via theme tokens; see AGENTS.md.

Before designing a page, read docs/ai/design-thinking.md: one job per page, content first, one control row, rare filters behind a popover, ≤ 5 numbers, say it once.

## Foundations

- [Logo](docs/ai/logo.md): The official VKS badge, redrawn as a vector from the brand file used in the QC dashboard. Same colours in both themes, because the badge carries its own field. Exports: Logo, LogoTile, BRAND
- [Performance tiers](docs/ai/performance.md): High-end vs low-end phone mode. Lite drops blur, looping motion and heavy shadows. Exports: PerfProvider, initPerf, PerfToggle, usePerf
- [Instant data](docs/ai/instant-data.md): Pages open instantly on a second visit: cached data paints at once, refreshes in the background; Back keeps filters and scroll. Exports: useData, prefetchData, invalidateData, mutateData, peekData, useScrollRestore, useStickyState
- [Hover effects](docs/ai/hover-effects.md): Premium mouse effects for desktop: spotlight, edge trace and 3D tilt on cards, mouse parallax, a sliding row highlight, icon nudge and a cursor ring for landing pages. Phones, lite mode and reduced motion get none of it. Exports: HoverFx, Parallax, ParallaxLayer, SlideHighlight, CursorRing, usePointerVars

## Actions

- [Button](docs/ai/button.md): The one button. Layered fill, inner highlight, tinted lift shadow and a sheen on hover. Presses land on an iOS spring. h-11 (44 px) on every size. Exports: Button, IconButton
- [Badge](docs/ai/badge.md): Small status pill. Tinted background + full-strength text so it passes contrast in both themes. Exports: Badge
- [Toggle](docs/ai/toggle.md): A button that stays pressed. ToggleGroup picks one (or many) of a few options; the segmented variant is the iOS control with a pill that springs under your choice. Exports: Toggle, ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem
- [Kbd, copy & separator](docs/ai/kbd-copy.md): Small helpers: keyboard hint, copy-to-clipboard with a tick, divider. Exports: Kbd, CopyButton, Separator
- [Button group](docs/ai/button-group.md): Joined buttons for a small set of related actions or views. Exports: ButtonGroup

## Form

- [Form dialog](docs/ai/form-dialog.md): The frame for every form in a popup: sticky title and footer, only the body scrolls and never sideways. sm / md / lg widths on desktop, a sheet on a phone. Field = label + control + error or hint; FormSection = a muted group title. Exports: FormDialogContent, Field, FormSection, FormActions, FoldSection, FormDialogSize
- [Weekday picker](docs/ai/weekday-picker.md): Seven 44 px day toggles (ຈ ອ ພ ພຫ ສ ສ ອາ), Monday first. Value is a 7-char mask like "1111100". workDaysText turns a mask into short Lao text. Exports: WeekdayPicker, workDaysText, workDaysCount, WEEKDAYS_LO, WEEKDAY_NAMES_LO
- [Settings page](docs/ai/settings-page.md): The one settings screen every app shares: 10 standard pages (ໂປຣໄຟລ໌, ຄວາມປອດໄພ, ແຈ້ງເຕືອນ, ການສະແດງຜົນ, ທົ່ວໄປ, ສະມາຊິກ & ສິດ, ການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່, ປະຫວັດ, ຂໍ້ມູນ, ເຂດອັນຕະລາຍ) plus one app page built only from 9 standard row types. View first: Profile and General show plain values with an ແກ້ໄຂ button per section (Edit → ບັນທຶກ / ຍົກເລີກ); preferences (toggles, matrices, display, app rows) save on their own with an Undo toast. Left nav + Ctrl K search; on a phone a grouped list that opens each page full screen. save() gets only the diff, which also feeds the audit log. Exports: SettingsPage, SettingsSection, SettingsRow, SettingsValue, SettingsEditBar, SettingsControl, SettingsSaveBar, SettingsHoldButton, SettingsTimeRange, defineSettings, settingsDiff
- [Facts](docs/ai/facts.md): The read-only half of view-first. Facts = label/value rows for a narrow side panel; FactGrid = label-over-value cells in 2 columns for a record popup. Empty values show —. Exports: Facts, FactGrid
- [Slider](docs/ai/slider.md): iOS-size 28 px thumb. While dragging the track thickens, a halo grows round the thumb, a value bubble springs up and Android phones tick on every step. Tick marks light up as the fill passes. Exports: Slider
- [Input & Textarea](docs/ai/input.md): 44 px tall, 16 px text (iOS never zooms), red border + shake when invalid. Exports: Input, Textarea, Label
- [Input types](docs/ai/input-types.md): The standard fields: text, phone (020 XXXX XXXX), money, time, number. Same 44 px / 16 px shell as Input, right keyboard on phones. Exports: TextInput, PhoneInput, MoneyInput, TimeInput, NumberInput, isPhoneLa, phoneLaE164
- [Select](docs/ai/select.md): Radix Select with a 44 px trigger. For long lists or search, use Combobox. Exports: Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectHeader
- [Checkbox & Switch](docs/ai/checkbox-switch.md): Press in and hold: the box sinks with a soft halo, the switch knob stretches into a pill. Let go: green grows out from the centre, the tick draws, the knob springs across and one ring pulses. Unticking is quicker and quiet. Both have a 44 px hit area and a tiny haptic on Android. Exports: Checkbox, Switch, Label
- [Tabs](docs/ai/tabs.md): Segmented tabs. Keep to 2-4 on a phone. Exports: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent
- [Combobox](docs/ai/combobox.md): Searchable picker. Bottom sheet on a phone, popover on desktop; inside a Dialog on a phone it pushes a view in the same sheet. Single or multi. Exports: Combobox, Option
- [Filter chips](docs/ai/filter-chips.md): Scrollable one-row chips for filtering lists. Better than a dropdown on a phone. Exports: FilterChips
- [Search box](docs/ai/search-box.md): Input with a search icon and a clear button. Exports: SearchBox
- [Radio group](docs/ai/radio-group.md): Pick exactly one of a few options, all visible at once. 44 px rows, the dot springs in. Exports: RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem
- [Stepper](docs/ai/stepper.md): − / + number control for small counts (qty, guards per shift). The digit rolls up or down. Exports: Stepper
- [OTP input](docs/ai/otp-input.md): One box per digit, numeric keyboard, pastes a whole code, shakes on error. Exports: OtpInput
- [Floating & password input](docs/ai/floating-input.md): Label floats up on focus; password has an animated show/hide eye. Exports: FloatingInput, PasswordInput
- [Chip](docs/ai/chip.md): Selectable filter pills and removable tags. Tap x: the x spins, the chip shrinks away, then the chips after it glide into the gap (including wrapping up to the line above). Exports: Chip
- [Dropzone](docs/ai/dropzone.md): Drag files in or click to pick. Checks type and size before upload. Exports: Dropzone, fmtBytes
- [Tag input](docs/ai/tag-input.md): Type and press Enter or comma. Paste a list, backspace to remove, suggestions below. Exports: TagInput, parseTags

## Dates

- [Date picker](docs/ai/date-picker.md): Lao month names, Monday first. Bottom sheet with a wheel on a phone, calendar popover on desktop. Exports: DatePicker, Calendar, DateWheel
- [Date range picker](docs/ai/date-range-picker.md): Report ranges with presets (today, last 7 days, this month…). One month on a phone sheet, two side by side on desktop. Exports: DateRangePicker, RangeCalendar, formatRange, Range
- [Time picker](docs/ai/time-picker.md): 24 h only. Tap an hour, then :00 / :15 / :30 / :45. TimeRangePicker adds a shift's end, a 24 h bar and length presets (12 / 8 ຊມ / ອື່ນໆ); overnight shows +1 ມື້. Popover on desktop, sheet on phone. Exports: TimePicker, TimeRangePicker, timeToMin, minToTime, spanMin, isHHMM

## Feedback

- [Alert](docs/ai/alert.md): Inline warning strip with a coloured left edge. Info, success, warning, danger. Exports: Alert
- [Close button](docs/ai/close-button.md): The one round X. 44 px hit area, quiet muted hover, a small press, Lao label ປິດ. Alert, Banner, Dialog, Sheet and Drawer all use it. Exports: CloseButton, CLOSE_BUTTON
- [Confirm popup](docs/ai/confirm-dialog.md): Warning popup before anything you cannot undo. Hold-to-confirm for the really dangerous ones, so a pocket tap can't delete. Exports: ConfirmDialog
- [Toast](docs/ai/toast.md): Sonner restyled to match IOSAlert: glass card with a gold hairline, round tone badge, spring entrance and a bar that drains while it stays. Top-center, away from the thumb. Success, error and finished promises buzz the phone. Exports: toast, Toaster
- [Loading & success](docs/ai/loading.md): Skeleton shimmer while loading, a spinner for short waits, and the animated check after a scan. Exports: Skeleton, Spinner, SuccessCheck, LiveDot
- [Offline & empty](docs/ai/offline-empty.md): Offline banner shows the number of scans waiting (classic bar, or the navy Dynamic-Island pill). Empty state with a floating icon orb for lists with nothing in them; Combobox, CommandPalette, NotificationList, IndexedList and DataTable use it too. Exports: OfflineBanner, Empty, PageBoundary, isChunkLoadError
- [Sync status](docs/ai/sync-status.md): Is my data on the server yet? Synced, pending N or failing, with the last sync time and a retry button. Reads the OfflineQueue from @vks-kit/core. Exports: SyncStatus, syncState, sinceLabel
- [Notification banner](docs/ai/banner.md): iOS push-style banner that springs down from the top. Swipe up or wait to dismiss, tap to open. Exports: Banner
- [Skeletons](docs/ai/skeletons.md): Shaped placeholders (text, avatar, list, card, table) so nothing jumps when data lands. Exports: SkeletonText, SkeletonList, SkeletonCard, SkeletonTable, SkeletonAvatar
- [Progress HUD](docs/ai/progress-hud.md): Centred dark square: spinner → tick or cross. Blocks taps while a save runs. Exports: useProgressHUD, ProgressHUD
- [Notification centre](docs/ai/notification-list.md): Grouped notifications with unread dots, mark-all and dismiss. Exports: NotificationList

## Overlays

- [Dialog](docs/ai/dialog.md): Bottom sheet on a phone (thumb reach), centred box on desktop. Gold top edge. Exports: Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogClose, InSheetView, useInSheet
- [Sheet](docs/ai/sheet.md): Slides in from the bottom, the right, or covers the whole screen. Exports: Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetTitle, SheetDescription
- [Drawer](docs/ai/drawer.md): Record detail panel. Full screen with a back arrow on a phone, side panel on desktop. Exports: Drawer
- [Tooltip](docs/ai/tooltip.md): Desktop hint only. Never put anything a phone user needs inside a tooltip. Three looks: dark (navy chip, default), light (card for longer help), glass (over maps, photos, charts). Optional arrow, key-shortcut hint and a bold title line. Tip is the one-line shortcut. Exports: TooltipProvider, Tip, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent
- [Lightbox](docs/ai/lightbox.md): Full screen photo viewer with swipe, arrows and a caption. For patrol photos. Exports: Lightbox, PhotoGrid
- [Detail popover](docs/ai/detail-popover.md): Popup detail information. Hover (or tap) a name, row or map pin and a rich card grows out of it from the side it opens on; rows stagger in. On a phone the same content rises as a bottom sheet. Exports: DetailPopover, DetailField
- [iOS alert](docs/ai/ios-alert.md): iOS alert behaviour in VKS style: spring zoom, round tone badge (info / success / warning / danger), gold glow + hairline, pill buttons. 2 buttons side by side, 3+ stacked. Exports: IOSAlert
- [Action sheet](docs/ai/action-sheet.md): iOS grouped buttons from the bottom with a separate Cancel. Exports: ActionSheet
- [Menu & popover](docs/ai/menu.md): Frosted iOS menu and a content popover. On desktop they spring out of their trigger; on a phone (under 640 px) both dock to the bottom as a sheet with a grabber, dimmed backdrop and 48 px rows. Exports: Menu, MenuTrigger, MenuContent, MenuItem, MenuLabel, MenuSeparator, Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent
- [Snap sheet](docs/ai/snap-sheet.md): Maps-style bottom sheet with detents (half / full). Drag the grabber; flick down to close. Exports: SnapSheet
- [Share sheet](docs/ai/share-sheet.md): Native OS share on phones; an iOS-style sheet (WhatsApp, LINE, Telegram, Facebook, copy link) on desktop. Exports: useShareSheet, ShareSheet
- [Hover card](docs/ai/hover-card.md): Rich preview when you hover a name or ID. Opens after 350 ms so it never flickers. Exports: HoverCard
- [Context menu](docs/ai/context-menu.md): Desktop-first: right-click menu (long-press works on phones but nobody discovers it, so give phones a visible ⋯ Menu or ActionSheet). Right-click (or long-press) menu with icons, shortcuts, sub-menus and a red destructive item. Exports: ContextMenu

## Data display

- [Card](docs/ai/card.md): The basic box. White on light, navy-ink on dark. Exports: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter
- [Data table](docs/ai/data-table.md): A table on desktop that turns into cards on a phone when there are more than 4 columns. Loading, error and empty states built in. Exports: DataTable, Column
- [Table](docs/ai/table.md): Plain table parts with a navy header. Every column can sort: pass sortKey + sort + onSort to TH. Exports: Table, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD
- [KPI hero card](docs/ai/kpi-hero.md): The phone version of KpiStrip: ONE big number with a trend pill and sparkline, plus up to 3 small figures underneath. Takes about a quarter of the screen instead of the whole first page. Exports: KpiHero
- [KPI strip](docs/ai/kpi-strip.md): Top-of-dashboard numbers for DESKTOP: 4 tiles in a row. On a phone use KpiHero (one hero card), because 4 tiles eat the first screen. Money uses ກີບ, never ₭. Exports: KpiStrip
- [Timeline](docs/ai/timeline.md): What happened on a shift, newest first. Exports: Timeline
- [Approval card](docs/ai/approval-card.md): One request that needs a yes or no from a manager: what, who asked, when. Approve, or Reject with a required reason. Exports: ApprovalCard, rejectReasonError, ApprovalStatus
- [Roadmap & dependency map](docs/ai/roadmap.md): Plan views. Roadmap: phases as bars across months (Gantt) with a progress fill, gold milestone diamonds and a red today line. DependencyMap: boxes in columns with arrows from what each one needs; hover or focus a box to light its whole chain. Both are click-to-open (pair with Drawer). Phone: both scroll sideways inside their card. Exports: Roadmap, DependencyMap, planPct, planMonths, layoutDeps, RoadmapRow, RoadmapMilestone, DepNode
- [Avatar & progress](docs/ai/avatar-progress.md): Initials avatar (works with Lao names) and a labelled progress bar. Exports: Avatar, AvatarGroup, UserChip, Progress, ProgressRing
- [Accordion](docs/ai/accordion.md): FAQ and long forms broken into parts. Exports: Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent
- [Star rating & pagination](docs/ai/rating-pagination.md): Inspection scores and paged lists. Both 44 px targets. Exports: StarRating, Pagination
- [Settings list](docs/ai/list-group.md): iOS Settings-style grouped rows with coloured icon tiles, switches and chevrons. Exports: ListGroup, ListRow
- [Number ticker](docs/ai/number-ticker.md): Counts smoothly to a new value. Jumps straight there on low-end phones. Exports: NumberTicker
- [Tree view](docs/ai/tree-view.md): Nested sites/folders. Arrow keys walk and open/close, rows slide in. Exports: TreeView, flattenTree
- [Stat card](docs/ai/stat-card.md): Dashboard KPI tile: number, coloured delta and a drawn-in trend line. Exports: StatCard, TrendLine
- [File icon](docs/ai/file-icon.md): Coloured file-type tile (PDF, Excel, Word, image…) and a file row with size, progress and remove. Exports: FileIcon, FileItem, fileKind, fileBadge

## Layout & navigation

- [App shell](docs/ai/app-shell.md): Whole-app frame. Navy sidebar on desktop, bottom nav + FAB on a phone. One breakpoint: 768 px. Pages slide in the direction you moved and a gold bar sweeps the header. Exports: AppShell, Fab, NavItem, ShellProfile
- [Sidebar](docs/ai/sidebar.md): Navy rail. The active pill springs between items with a gold edge and a glow behind the icon; icons pop when clicked; the logo spins in once. Collapses to a 72 px icon rail with tooltips. Exports: Sidebar, SidebarSheet
- [Bottom nav & FAB](docs/ai/bottom-nav.md): 56 px tall tabs above the phone's home bar. The FAB sits above it on the right. Exports: BottomNav, Fab
- [Page header](docs/ai/page-header.md): Title, subtitle and actions. Actions hide on a phone: put the main one in the FAB. Exports: PageHeader, LargeTitleBar
- [Login card](docs/ai/login-card.md): Compact centred sign-in card with the logo shine, for simple apps and phones. For a full-page split-screen login with a brand panel use LoginScreen instead. Exports: LoginCard
- [Login screen](docs/ai/login-screen.md): Premium full-page sign-in (for the compact centred card use LoginCard instead). Desktop: navy aurora brand panel with feature list beside the form. Phone: logo on top, form centred, safe-area padding. Exports: LoginScreen
- [Profile view](docs/ai/profile-view.md): Employee / account profile. Desktop: sticky identity card on the left, grouped settings on the right. Phone: an iOS-contact-style header (big avatar, round call / message / edit buttons) edge to edge, then one stacked column. Exports: ProfileView, ProfileSection, ProfileRow, ProfileQuickAction
- [Wizard](docs/ai/wizard.md): Multi-step form with a step bar. Long forms on a phone should always be a wizard. Exports: Wizard
- [Step progress](docs/ai/step-progress.md): Compact 'Step 2 of 4' bar for long phone forms where the full wizard header won't fit. Exports: StepProgress
- [Bottom toolbar](docs/ai/bottom-toolbar.md): Frosted row of actions for the current screen. Actions, not places (that is BottomNav). Exports: BottomToolbar
- [Command palette (⌘K)](docs/ai/command-palette.md): Ctrl/⌘ K opens a fuzzy search over pages and actions. Arrow keys + Enter. Works in Lao. Exports: CommandPalette, useCommandK
- [Breadcrumb](docs/ai/breadcrumb.md): Where am I, one click up. Long paths collapse the middle into … Exports: Breadcrumb
- [Split pane](docs/ai/split-pane.md): List | detail with a draggable divider. Remembers its size. Exports: SplitPane
- [Scroll area](docs/ai/scroll-area.md): Thin overlay scrollbar that matches the theme on Windows desktops. Exports: ScrollArea

## Mobile & touch

- [Pull to refresh & swipe row](docs/ai/touch.md): The two gestures guards already know from other apps. Both have a button fallback for accessibility. Exports: PullToRefresh, SwipeRow
- [Search bar](docs/ai/search-bar.md): iOS search pill: clear button while typing, Cancel slides in on focus. Exports: SearchBar
- [Carousel](docs/ai/carousel.md): CSS scroll-snap cards with the next one peeking. Dots on phone, arrows on desktop. No JS animation. Exports: Carousel
- [Indexed list](docs/ai/indexed-list.md): Contacts-style list with sticky letters and a scrub rail. Lao lead vowels sort correctly (ເພັດ under ພ). Exports: IndexedList, groupByIndex, indexKey
- [Long press](docs/ai/long-press.md): Hold-to-act hook. Cancels if the finger moves, so it never fights scrolling. Exports: useLongPress

## Heavy (lazy)

- [Charts · Trends](docs/ai/charts.md): Recharts wrapped in theme colours (chart-1…5 flip with the theme): gradient fills, VKS card tooltip, tap-to-hide legend pills, entry animation (off for reduced motion / lite). Bar, Line, Area, Combo and Sparkline: values over time. ~105 KB gzip, so load it only on report pages. Phone: they simply fill the card width, axes stay 12 px; keep to 7 or fewer x labels. Siblings: Charts · Share & compare, Charts · Schedules & grids. Exports: BarSeries, LineSeries, AreaSeries, ComboSeries, Sparkline, ChartTip, ChartLegend
- [Charts · Share & compare](docs/ai/charts-share.md): Parts of a whole and comparisons: Donut, RadialBars, Scatter / bubble and Radar. Phone: Donut and RadialBars scale as they are; RadarSeries switches by its own width to a bar-per-axis comparison list, because radar labels collide on a 320 px card (industry practice: radar is desktop, bars are the phone equivalent). Pass compact to force either form. Exports: Donut, RadialBars, ScatterSeries, RadarSeries
- [Charts · Schedules & grids](docs/ai/charts-schedule.md): Calendar-shaped charts from the VKS apps: Heatmap, DateGrid (QC site profile), LatencyTimeline (patrol latency site profile) and AttendanceBoard (HRM ຕິດຕາມການມາວຽກ). Each has a real phone form chosen by its own width, not the screen: DateGrid becomes one tappable row per round (mini status strip) that opens a bottom sheet with the days, Heatmap scales, LatencyTimeline becomes a month calendar with gap chips and tapping a visited day opens a bottom sheet, AttendanceBoard becomes one tappable row per guard that opens a bottom sheet with the month. Phone tap targets are 44 px. Exports: Heatmap, DateGrid, LatencyTimeline, AttendanceBoard
- [Map](docs/ai/map.md): Leaflet + OpenStreetMap with VKS controls: glass 44 px zoom + 'fit all pins' buttons, pulsing token pins (danger pulses faster), Noto Sans Lao card tooltips (tone dot, title, sub line, time), an optional pin card that springs up when a pin is tapped (phones have no hover, so this is how they read details), always-on labels, and a tiny © OSM credit (required by the OSM licence). Defaults to Vientiane. ~43 KB gzip. Exports: MapView, Pin
- [Kanban](docs/ai/kanban.md): Task board. Desktop: drag cards between columns (keyboard: Space + arrows). Phone: no dragging — one column per screen with count tabs, swipe between columns, tap a card to move it from a bottom sheet. ~17 KB gzip. Exports: Kanban, moveCard, KanbanCard
- [QR scan & photo](docs/ai/scan.md): Camera QR scanner (jsQR) and a photo button that shrinks to 1280 px / 70 % JPEG before upload. ~48 KB gzip. Exports: QrScanner, PhotoCapture
- [Capture stamp (photo & video)](docs/ai/capture-stamp.md): The time / site / GPS card the Patrol app burns into photos and video frames: top-left capture time, bottom-right site + GPS, top-right brand pill. One drawing function, so the live preview and the saved file look identical. Lao text wraps without splitting tone marks. Exports: drawCaptureStamp, stampPhoto, stampTime, CaptureStamp, CaptureStampData
- [Signature pad](docs/ai/signature-pad.md): Finger signature for hand-overs. Read it back as a PNG. Exports: SignaturePad, SignaturePadHandle
